interface.title: BioManager (Rivera Lab demo)
interface.field: Lab management for animal colonies (mouse, fish, fly, worm, plant), molecular biology and lab inventory
interface.stage_of_work: Day-to-day colony husbandry, experiment bookkeeping and lab supply management (before and during experiments)
interface.what_it_is_for: A shared web workspace where a lab tracks its animals, cages, racks, litters, matings, experiments, plasmids and reagents/orders as editable tables, and sees what needs doing today.

data.note: Seeded demo lab 'Rivera Lab' (racks A/B, cages 101–114, strains, litters L-1..L-23, one experiment, 7 reagents, 6 orders, 8 plasmids, one with a GenBank sequence). There were no test files, so no sequence was uploaded; the plasmid map used the seeded pCAG-EGFP.

tree.general: Run a research mouse colony, its experiments and the lab's supplies from one shared record instead of spreadsheets
tree.specific: Manage the Rivera Lab mouse colony, a weight experiment, reagents/orders and plasmid viewing in BioManager (mouse only; other organism databases, calendar and notebook were not covered)

features.name: Drag-and-drop rack grid with highlight and click-to-add
features.general: Show storage positions as a lettered/numbered grid of tiles; highlight tiles matching a search, drag a tile to a new slot, and click an empty slot to create a new item there with its position prefilled
features.specific: Cages → Rack grid: pick Rack A/B, type in Highlight… to outline matching cages, drag cage tiles between cells ('Moved 106 to Rack A · B4'), click an empty cell to open New cage at that position

type text in Highlight to outline matching tiles
drag a tile to an empty cell (toast confirms new position)

save; new tile appears in the cell

read the due-date badges on the card (Wean date, genotype-by date)
press Genotyping → Create litter to create pup records
press Wean, edit destination rows (new cage label or existing cage)
press Wean and move

Did not read the chart for a real treatment-vs-control difference over time: only one weighing day with one mouse per group was recorded, so the chart shows two day-1 points; per-day test stars/table and Export were not reached. The cohort was the mating pair 27 and 30
Tracking which cage a mated animal returns to: no field for this was found. I recorded the origin cages (111, 112) in the breeding cage's Notes and did not move mice 27 and 30 back
